name: Sinful soul
source:
The player finds themselves in the shoes of our main character, who is given a one-time chance to pursue the life he always dreamed of, faced with a decision that could change his fate forever. "The Sinful Soul" club inviting players to join a private club where it is possible to fulfill even the most sinful and daring desires.

However, otherworldly forces conspire to manipulate his choice and lead him down the path of damnation, taking away everything that holds dear. In this game, your choices shape the story as you progress. Will you face eternal damnation, or will you find heaven on Earth?
Your fate is in your hands.

From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2308540/Sinful_soul]Steam[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演主角，获得一次千载难逢的机会，去追寻自己梦寐以求的生活。他面临的抉择，或许会永远改变自己的命运。“罪恶之魂”俱乐部邀请玩家加入这家私人会所，在这里，即使是最罪恶、最大胆的欲望，也有可能实现。

然而，异界的力量正密谋操纵他的选择，引诱他走向毁灭，夺走他珍视的一切。在本作中，你的选择将塑造故事的发展。你会陷入永恒的沉沦，还是找到人间天堂？
命运掌握在你手中。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2308540/Sinful_soul]Steam[/url]]
